From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Cc: 
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Calibration: variance spotlight + proposed adjudication matrix

Team —

Attached the Q2 "variance spotlight" PDF and a working adjudication matrix (xlsx). I pulled a per-subteam variance heatmap and flagged ~18 outliers where peer medians diverge by 1.0+ band and we have sparse evidence in the comments field. Two asks:

1) Quick read & annotate: Please open the PDF and mark any cases you think are evidence-poor AND material (i.e., promotion, off-cycle comp, or potential HR escalation) by EOD Wednesday (2027-06-16).

2) Breakouts & owners: I propose we run two 30min breakout sessions on Thursday — one for Product/Eng adjacent teams and one for GTM/CS-facing teams. Marcus/Lauren to run the GTM session; Laura/Rishi to run the Product/Eng session. I'll join both and collect the adjudication decisions into the matrix.

Notes:
- Where managers disagree on a band with no supporting examples, the default will be to hold the band until we get confirmatory qualitative evidence or manager notes.
- Where a manager is indicating a 1-band upward adjustment tied to a single metric (e.g., NRR uplift), we should ask for multiple supporting datapoints or peer comparisons.

Attachments: variance-spotlight-q2-2027.pdf (heatmap + per-employee summaries), adjudication-matrix-v1.xlsx, calibration-breakouts-agenda.docx

If any of you foresee blocked items (e.g., managers out on leave), flag here and I'll coordinate.

Thanks —
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni

Vivek —

Thanks for pulling this. I skimmed the heatmap and left inline comments on 6 cases where the "manager justification" field is blank or only mentions a single project. Two quick notes:

- Team A (Eng infra) has a cluster of "higher" bands, but a lot of the work was cross-team support rather than sustained impact. I suggest we ask the manager to provide 2 deliverables (date + artifact) before confirming an upward move.

- One protective case: Eng -> Product IC with strong mentorship + cross-team ownership. If Marcus/Lauren see this in GTM, we can mark as "documented promotable" and then move to HR review.

I'll be available for the product/eng breakout at 11:00 on Thursday. I've uploaded a short 1-pager with suggested evidence prompts to the Drive link.

Laura Bennett
